body:
New project `research/heterogeneous-steps` (MIT): DiLoCo-style local SGD where workers run different numbers of inner steps.

- Exact stationary floor for weighted averaging, matched to simulation within ~1%.
- Worker information `I∞·tanh(λH/2)` saturates; optimal weights span ≤2×, so equal weights lose ≤9/8 (measured ≤1.09).
- Step-proportional (FedAvg-style) weights lose up to 1.76× per mode, 10.5× on three modes.
- 9 tests, white paper, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
